criteria.deficiency: The column does not implement the reference's completion-time freeze. Once a task reaches completed >= total, the candidate keeps showing growing elapsed time until the Progress context exits, whereas the reference freezes it at the completion moment via Task.finished_time. This is a user-visible behavioral difference from the reference, which is the source of truth. Fix: track finished_time on Task (set in update/advance when completed >= total, cleared in reset) and have TimeElapsedColumn render finished_time when the task is finished. The candidate does not change Task.finished, which matches the reference's need only partially.
